transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I’ve just been feeling really slowed down lately. At work, my hands feel like they’re moving through glue or something. Even simple stuff like sectioning hair or mixing color takes me forever now, and people have started noticing I’m not as quick as I used to be.
Do you ever get stuck and find that you can’t move at all, even when you want to?

Not like I’m completely frozen or can’t move at all. It’s more that everything feels really slow, especially my hands at work—like sectioning hair or mixing color takes way longer than it should, and people have noticed I’m slower.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually energized or high and needed much less sleep than usual?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had times where I stayed up late, but not where I felt unusually high or energized and didn’t need sleep.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yeah… most days I wake up already feeling really low. It’s like this heavy, flat sadness in my chest, and I keep thinking there’s no point in trying to build the life I thought I was going to have.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?

Yeah… sometimes. Like when I’m sweeping up or rinsing bowls at the salon, I’ll hear a woman’s voice near the shampoo stations saying I’m ruining everything. But then I look, and the salon’s empty, or nobody’s anywhere close by.
Have you ever heard that voice during a time when you were not feeling depressed?

Yeah. Before the depression really got bad, there were a few weeks where I was still getting up and going to work like normal, or mostly normal. But I was already hearing that voice, and I was convinced someone at the salon was messing with my schedule.
Have people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that your thoughts seem jumbled?
I don’t think so. Nobody’s really told me that my speech is hard to follow. I mean, sometimes I lose my train of thought, but I haven’t noticed people saying I sound jumbled.
Have you lost interest in seeing other people or doing things you used to enjoy?

Yeah. I used to like talking with clients and helping the newer stylists at work. I’d go hiking with friends too. Lately I mostly just keep my head down and avoid people. I don’t really have that spark in me anymore.
Before you started feeling depressed, were you already pulling away from people or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?

I think it started around then, yeah. I used to be more social at work—chatting with clients, helping the newer stylists—and I’d go hiking with friends. But I started just keeping my head down and avoiding people. It was like I didn’t have that spark anymore.
Before you started feeling depressed, did you already feel emotionally flat or like you had very little motivation?

Yeah, I think so. Even before I felt really depressed, I was already kind of pulling back. I used to chat with clients, help the newer stylists, go hiking with friends… and then I just started keeping my head down and avoiding people. I just didn’t have that spark or motivation like I used to.
For at least 2 weeks, have you heard that voice during a time when you were not feeling depressed?

Yes. Before the depression really took over, there were a few weeks where I was still getting up and working, functioning more normally, but I was already hearing the voice. I also felt really sure someone at the salon was messing with my schedule.
Have there been times when you held a strange posture or stayed very still for a long time, even when there was no clear reason to?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I might sit around when I’m feeling low, but not like being stuck in a posture or staying frozen for no reason.
Was there ever a period of at least 2 weeks when you were hearing the voice or felt people were interfering with your schedule, but you were not feeling depressed?

Yes. Like I said, before the depression really hit, there were a few weeks where I was still getting up and going to work, doing things more normally. But I was already hearing the voice, and I felt pretty sure someone at the salon was messing with my schedule.
At the same time you were hearing the voice, were you completely free of depressed mood?

I wouldn’t say completely free, but before the depression really took over there was a stretch of several weeks where I was still getting up and functioning pretty normally. During that time I was already hearing the voice and feeling sure someone at the salon was interfering with my schedule.
For at least 1 month, have you been hearing that voice or believing someone at the salon was interfering with your schedule?
Yes. It’s been way longer than a month. The voice and that feeling that someone is targeting my bookings at the salon have been going on for about a year and four months now.
For at least 1 month, were you already emotionally flat or unmotivated before the depression began?

Yes, I think so. Before I got really depressed, I had already kind of changed for at least a month. I used to talk more with clients, help the newer stylists, go hiking with friends… but I started mostly keeping my head down and avoiding people. I just didn’t feel like I had that spark in me anymore.
At any time while you were hearing the voice or believed someone was interfering with your schedule, were you completely free of depression for at least 2 weeks?

Yes. Before the depression really took over, there were several weeks where I wasn’t feeling depressed like that yet. I was still getting up and doing things pretty normally, but I was already hearing the voice and I was already convinced someone at the salon was messing with my schedule.
Before the depression started, did you already seem emotionally flat to other people?

Yes, I think so. People probably noticed I wasn’t as friendly or lively. I used to talk a lot with clients, help the newer stylists, and go hiking with friends, but I started keeping my head down and avoiding people. I just didn’t feel like I had that spark anymore.
Have you been acting in a very disorganized or bizarre way that other people found hard to understand?

I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve been acting bizarre on purpose or anything. I guess I may have seemed off or hard to follow at times, but I haven’t really noticed myself doing anything extremely disorganized.
During that period before the depression started, were the voice and the belief about your schedule happening every day?

Yes, during that stretch it was happening regularly. I was still getting up and functioning more normally, but I was already hearing the voice and feeling really sure someone at the salon was messing with my schedule.
